correlations.why: a coefficient here describes these 31 windows. With 1 positive it is not an estimate of anything and no threshold follows from it; 30 per cell would be the floor.

leave_one_out.why: a contrast that changes sign when one window is removed was that window, not a habitat characteristic. A drop that DESTROYS the contrast -- emptying a cell -- is counted too: with one positive window, removing it leaves nothing to contrast, and calling that 'no sign flip' would make a single observation look robust.

oracle_bound.why: PERFECT FORESIGHT. Every good window is kept by construction, so the retained share is 1.0 by definition and means nothing on its own. The number that matters is how much exposure is avoided -- the ceiling on what any real selector could be worth. It is not a strategy and cannot be run.
